_comment: SITE IDENTITY — GENERIC DEMO edition (branch: demo -> demo.cairnready.org).
Every {{SITE.key}} token in any .html file (and .webmanifest) is replaced with
the value here at build time (build.mjs); the build FAILS on an unknown or
leftover token, so identity can never silently half-apply.
This branch exists so cairnready.org can link to a real, working manual that
names no hospital. It tracks main (the LRH edition) and re-applies this
generic overlay on top — see SITES.md.
Clinical thresholds do NOT live here. They stay in each tool's marked
SITE CONFIG block, next to the logic that uses them and the citation for them.
title: CairnReady Emergency Manual
editionNote: Generic demo edition — not localized to any hospital. Every threshold, dose, phone number, and cart location must be validated and localized by your site before clinical use.
footerLine: CairnReady Emergency Manual — generic demo edition · localize before clinical use
_feedbackEmailNote: Where the FEEDBACK button in every tool sends mail. Trunk-side this token replaced a hardcoded personal address that would have misrouted every fork's feedback; for LRH specifically it stays Lon's own address, since he is this edition's maintainer.
